definitions.explanation: Describes something of great importance or significance.
Describes something treasured or held dear.
Describes a serious or grave situation (often in 大事になる).

examples.english: Take care (of yourself). / Get well soon.
examples.notes: Set expression for someone who is sick

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}を{大事|だいじ}にしてください。
{健康|けんこう}は{大事|だいじ}なので、{毎日|まいにち}{運動|うんどう}しています。
examples.english: Health is important, so I exercise every day.

examples.japanese: これは{大事|だいじ}な{書類|しょるい}だから、なくさないでください。
examples.english: This is an important document, so please don't lose it.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}にならなくてよかった。すごく{心配|しんぱい}していたから。
examples.english: I'm glad it didn't become serious. I was really worried.
examples.notes: {大事|だいじ}になる = to become serious/a big deal

examples.japanese: {勉強|べんきょう}は{大事|だいじ}だと{思|おも}います。
{大事|だいじ}なことを{忘|わす}れていた。
{時間|じかん}を{大事|だいじ}にしてください。
この{本|ほん}は{祖父|そふ}からもらった{大事|だいじ}なものです。
examples.english: This book is a precious thing I got from my grandfather.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}を{大事|だいじ}にしなさい。
{命|いのち}は{大事|だいじ}にしなければならない。
{小|ちい}さな{事故|じこ}が{大事|だいじ}になることもある。
examples.english: A small accident can become something serious.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}を{取|と}って{今日|きょう}は{休|やす}みます。
examples.english: I'll take it easy and rest today.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}が{大事|だいじ}にならないように{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the hospital so the injury wouldn't become serious.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}をひいたので、{大事|だいじ}を{取|と}って{早|はや}めに{寝|ね}た。
examples.english: I caught a cold, so I took care and went to bed early.

notes:
{大事|だいじ} is a na-adjective meaning 'important,' 'valuable,' or 'serious.'

Forms:
- Adverbial: {大事|だいじ}に
- Modifier: {大事|だいじ}な + noun

Conjugation:
- Negative: {大事|だいじ}ではない / {大事|だいじ}じゃない
- Te-form: {大事|だいじ}で
- Past: {大事|だいじ}だった

Key expressions:
- 〜を{大事|だいじ}にする: to cherish, to take care of, to value
- お{大事|だいじ}に: Take care / Get well soon (said to someone who is sick)
- {大事|だいじ}になる: to become serious/a big deal

Similar words:
- {大事|だいじ} vs. {大切|たいせつ}: Both mean 'important/precious.' {大切|たいせつ} emphasizes emotional value and care; {大事|だいじ} is broader and can include 'serious (matter).'
- {大事|だいじ} vs. {重要|じゅうよう}: {重要|じゅうよう} is more formal and objective, often used for official/business matters.
